notes.title: Update v1.2.0
notes.content:
Gambling game added.


Added ranking of maximum D-points owned.

Gambling game
It can be played by selecting Gaming from Single Player.
The wagering game is a game in which you predict the winner from 8 warriors.
You can increase your points by using D-Points to guess the winner.
D-points are earned by playing games.

notes.title: Update v1.1.0
notes.content:
When a player runs out of power in single-player mode, he or she can now be revived.


Fixed a problem in which when a match was played in multiplayer mode with an additional CPU, there was no CPU in the final result.
